name: Maasvlakte Rotterdam
normalized_note: Setting reference for THREAT IMMINENT, the finale of Ducky's Game 1 campaign, DO RIGHT, FEAR NONE.

name: Contested NMESIS launcher and mobile command post position
normalized_note: This is the position the player must reach and secure to launch a Naval Strike Missile at Severomorsk. The launcher and mobile command post occupy a camouflaged position in a small employee parking lot.

name: RETREAT, HELL Russian amphibious landing location
normalized_note: The Russian Zubr-class landing craft come ashore on this beach during the approach to the campaign finale in RETREAT, HELL.

name: Rendezvous with Dutch Marine forward observers
normalized_note: Ducky and the Dutch Marine squad leader exchange tactical updates. Ducky reports the recently observed Russian amphibious landing, and the Dutch squad leader briefs AEGIS on the local defense plan. The team is then directed to the quay, where Dutch Navy personnel will transport them through the inner Europoort channels toward the Maasvlakte terminal sector in a RHIB.

name: Reach the Dutch Navy RHIB on the jetty
normalized_note: The player moves roughly two-thirds of the way down the busy jetty to reach the Dutch Navy RHIB. After a short dialogue beat, the player is prompted to embark, triggering the scripted transportation sequence toward the Maasvlakte terminal sector.

name: RHIB landing location
normalized_note: The Dutch Navy RHIB drops AEGIS at the end of the jetty near the oil-storage tanks. The player proceeds down the jetty and through the storage-tank section to meet the local defense command. This transition marks the end of RETREAT, HELL and the beginning of THREAT IMMINENT.

name: Port Defense Forward Command Post
normalized_note: The player reaches the Dutch Navy and Marine Corps forward defense command post inside this building. The local commander briefs AEGIS on a still-operational NMESIS launcher and mobile command post northwest of this position, deep inside a contested terminal sector that Russian forces are attempting to seize. The battery must not be destroyed or captured, because losing it would leave the already exposed terminal infrastructure even more vulnerable. Ducky leads the team northwest toward the NMESIS position.

name: Rendezvous with forward Dutch Marine elements
normalized_note: The player helps a Dutch Marine squad defeat Russian troops across the open terminal service yard south of ECT Delta. Dutch Marine fire teams use service vehicles and yard equipment for cover while enemies fight from behind containers in the adjoining storage area. After the position is cleared, an allied artillery-support element deploys smoke to cover AEGIS and the Dutch Marines as they advance on ECT Delta.

name: ECT Delta terminal (8202)
normalized_note: AEGIS and the accompanying Dutch Marine elements cross the southern storage yard under smoke cover, then clear and secure ECT Delta terminal.

name: Frost's first overwatch vantage point
normalized_note: Frost takes position on top of this harbor crane to cover the first leg of the team's northwest movement toward the NMESIS position.

name: Northern container-yard gate
normalized_note: Ducky, Switchblade, and Lupin exit the container yard and use stationary railcars as cover while crossing the road and an open grass strip to reach Dutch Marines in the service yard farther north.

name: Electrical transformer station strike
normalized_note: As the player leaves ECT Delta and pushes north, Russian naval gunfire strikes this transformer-station building. The impact transforms the battlefield, creates an immediate shelling hazard, and forces the team to divert northeast toward the fire station rather than continuing directly northwest. The diversion keeps AEGIS out of the active impact zone during the approach to NMESIS.

name: Coloradoweg local fire station
normalized_note: Following the transformer-station strike, AEGIS and the Dutch Marine elements move east to the Coloradoweg fire station. They make contact with additional Dutch Army and Marine Corps personnel, who confirm that the Maasvlakte power plant remains under Dutch control. The team then advances toward the main power-plant building.

name: Frost's second overwatch position
normalized_note: After the team confirms that the power plant remains secure, Frost moves north and takes an overwatch position on the roof of the northern block building, covering the rest of AEGIS during its approach to the main power-plant building.

name: Maasvlakte power-plant main-building cargo bay
normalized_note: Ducky, Lupin, and Switchblade encounter a small Russian forward-scout team that includes a UAV operator. The threat forces the player to reduce their signature and call on Frost to eliminate the UAV operator before the squad engages the remaining scouts. After clearing the position, AEGIS reaches the main building's cargo bay. A Dutch Army commander in the loading area reports suspected enemy forward observers nearby who may be correcting Russian naval gunfire onto the plant.

name: Frost's third overwatch position
normalized_note: Once Ducky, Lupin, and Switchblade securely reach the cargo bay and link up with Dutch Army personnel and friendly site-security contractors operating under Dutch military coordination, Frost advances along the cleared route and takes position on the main building's roof. This gives him the elevated field of view required to cover the final approach and locate the suspected enemy observation team.

name: Lupin's overwatch position for the final NMESIS approach
normalized_note: Before Ducky and Switchblade assault the contested missile position, Lupin takes an elevated position on the northern storage tank to cover them. Lupin's playable sequence begins only after Ducky launches the missile and an RPG strike disables and overturns the NMESIS command post.

name: Final approach through the service lot
normalized_note: Ducky, Lupin, and Switchblade cross this service lot using stored cargo and stationary vehicles for cover. Dutch Marine elements regroup with AEGIS at the entrance after leaving the power plant and provide additional fire support during the final approach.

name: Severomorsk NSM impact position
normalized_note: Severomorsk occupies this offshore position during the finale and is struck here by the Naval Strike Missile launched by Ducky.

name: Regroup with Dutch Marine elements to end the mission
normalized_note: An RPG fired by an initial Russian Spetsnaz shock element disables and overturns the NMESIS mobile command post. Ducky escapes through the hatch while Lupin covers him from the elevated storage-tank position, and AEGIS and nearby Dutch forces eliminate the initial attackers. During the final movement to the regroup point, the player fights the main Russian Spetsnaz team, personally commanded in the field by Kapitan, as it attempts to breach the terminal's controlled perimeter. After defeating Kapitan's team, Ducky and the surviving AEGIS members reach the Dutch Marines in this parking lot. Ducky calls Frost in to regroup. A brief closing dialogue between Ducky, his squad, and the terminal defense commander ends the campaign.

name: Enemy forward-observation team position
normalized_note: During the approach to the main power-plant building, Lupin spots a second Russian team moving into a position near pipelines and oil-storage tanks north of the scout-team fight. Their equipment and behavior indicate that they are observing the terminal and correcting naval gunfire from the Russian ships offshore. Frost advances to the power-plant roof, triggering a perspective shift to his point of view. The player must identify and eliminate the forward-observation personnel while Ducky, Lupin, and Switchblade move toward the service-lot entrance and prepare for the final approach.

name: AEGIS amphibious-landing observation position
normalized_note: From this concealed position, Ducky and AEGIS observe the Russian amphibious landing and report it to allied command.

name: Second Russian naval-gunfire impact zone
normalized_note: The bombardment strikes the eastern side of the quay-adjacent building, causing the building's eastern half to collapse and ignite.

name: APM Terminals Maasvlakte II — AEGIS infrastructure node
normalized_note: The APM terminal complex contains telecommunications, network, computing, and logistics infrastructure integrated into AEGIS as a source of real-time global logistics and geospatial data. The same infrastructure supports autonomous warehouse systems, processes operational data, and manages vessel tasking. Critical compute and relay hardware is located beneath the complex, but the surface buildings, local power supply, and surrounding Maasvlakte infrastructure must remain operational. If the complex loses reliable connectivity or power, both the AEGIS compute-and-relay layer and the automated warehouse and logistics-coordination layer are likely to fail even if NATO retains physical control of the terminal. Such a failure would cause major strategic and material losses to the allied war effort.
